fact: Since 2012 the Ministry of Health has run the DHIS2-powered HMIS countrywide, covering health facility level data from all service areas, though use of its dashboards at facility and district level remains limited.
title: Improving data use and participatory action and design to support data use: the case of DHIS2 in Rwanda
publisher: University of Oslo / HISP Rwanda (IDIDT 2021 proceedings)
